points.K4: 有专门的职业接触标准

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜旁，柜里有一瓶空白标签的溶剂
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a chemical fume hood with a brown solvent bottle with a blank label inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲二氯甲烷的安全使用。

shots.scene: 溶剂瓶旁浮现健康危害和感叹号象形图
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a blank label next to a health hazard pictogram and an exclamation mark pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 它是常用溶剂，也是有毒化学品。

shots.scene: 阿杰把装溶剂的烧杯放在台面上敞着，戴着普通手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leaves an open beaker of solvent on an open bench to evaporate, wearing thin blue gloves.
shots.narration: 阿杰把萃取液敞在台面上，等它挥干。

shots.scene: 阿杰揉着太阳穴，打了个哈欠
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rubs his temples and yawns, looking dizzy, with faint vapor lines around the beaker.
shots.narration: 没多久，他觉得头晕、发困。

shots.scene: 小研打开通风柜，把烧杯移进去，扶阿杰到门口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the beaker into the fume hood and helps the young male student toward the doorway for fresh air.
shots.narration: 小研把烧杯移进通风柜，带他去透气。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶一个大问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a big question mark above him, next to a solvent bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 就是个溶剂，还要专门培训？

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜头点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods at the camera with a raised finger.
shots.narration: 要，因为它的危害容易被小看。

shots.scene: 人体示意图，心脏、肝脏、大脑依次亮起红色
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body diagram with the heart, the liver and the brain lighting up red one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 长期或反复大量接触，伤心、伤肝、伤脑。

shots.scene: 日历上一页页翻过，人形图标逐渐变灰
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by while a person pictogram slowly turns gray. No people.
shots.narration: 伤害是慢慢积累的，不能等有感觉。

shots.scene: 人形图标胸前出现健康危害象形图
shots.prompt_en: A person silhouette icon with a health hazard pictogram on its chest. No people.
shots.narration: 还可能增加患癌的风险。

shots.section_title: 有专门的职业接触标准
shots.scene: 一本空白标准文本，封面上是天平图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard document with a scales of justice icon on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 因为危害明确，有专门的职业接触标准。
overlay: 有专门的职业接触标准

shots.section_title: 有专门的职业接触标准
shots.scene: 王老师指着书架上的空白法规文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank binder of occupational health regulations on a shelf.
shots.narration: 我国职业病防治法规也有相应要求。

shots.scene: 仓库里一排排化学品桶
shots.prompt_en: Rows of large blue chemical drums on warehouse shelves with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 这类标准，起因是工业上的大量使用。

shots.scene: 大桶缩小成实验室的小瓶，盾牌图标不变
shots.prompt_en: A large drum shrinks into a small lab bottle, while a shield icon beside it stays the same size. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室用量小，规矩一样都不能少。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白风险评估表讨论
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student review a blank risk assessment form at a desk.
shots.narration: 重视危害，确认控制措施真的有效。

shots.scene: 溶剂瓶开口处冒出大量蒸气线，旁边沸腾温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: Many vapor lines rise quickly from an open solvent bottle, with a low thermometer icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 它沸点低，一开盖就挥发很快。

shots.scene: 蒸气从桌面流下，在地面低处聚成一片
shots.prompt_en: Colored vapor flows down off a bench and pools along the floor in a low corner. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸气比空气重，会往低处积聚。

shots.scene: 小研举起空白SDS，指着瓶上的象形图标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a blank safety data sheet and points at the pictograms on the bottle label.
shots.narration: 用前读SDS和标签，了解它的特性。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里用瓶口分液器取液，柜门拉低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat, goggles and gloves, dispenses solvent inside the fume hood with the sash pulled low.
shots.narration: 取用、分装，都在通风柜里做。

shots.scene: 台面上敞口挥干溶剂的烧杯被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an open beaker of solvent evaporating on an open bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不在台面上敞口挥干。

shots.scene: 浓缩装置放在通风柜里，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A solvent evaporation setup placed inside a fume hood, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸发浓缩，也要在通风条件下进行。

shots.scene: 小研随手盖紧瓶盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student caps the solvent bottle tightly right after use.
shots.narration: 用完随手盖紧，少一分挥发。

shots.scene: 溶剂滴落在蓝色薄手套上，很快渗进去
shots.prompt_en: A drop of solvent lands on a thin blue glove and quickly soaks through to the inside. No people.
shots.narration: 它能很快穿透常见的薄手套。

shots.scene: 几副不同材质手套，旁边空白SDS和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Several pairs of gloves of different materials next to a blank safety data sheet and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 按SDS和耐渗透资料，选对手套材质。

shots.scene: 小研发现手套沾了溶剂，立即脱下扔进废物桶，再洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student notices a splash on her glove, removes it at once into a waste bin, and washes her hands.
shots.narration: 一旦沾上，立刻换手套、洗手。

shots.scene: 两个废液桶，空白标签上分别有卤素图标和普通图标
shots.prompt_en: Two closed waste solvent containers side by side, their blank labels marked with different simple icons. No people.
shots.narration: 二氯甲烷是含卤溶剂，废液单独收集。

shots.scene: 小研把废液倒入托盘里的含卤废液桶，盖紧
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours waste solvent into a container standing in a spill tray inside the hood, then closes the lid.
shots.narration: 倒进专用桶，放在托盘里，盖紧。

shots.scene: 倒进水槽、敞口废液桶两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: solvent poured down a sink, and an open waste container without a lid. No people.
shots.narration: 不倒下水道，桶口不敞开。

shots.scene: 人形图标头上冒出晕眩螺旋
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with dizzy spirals above its head next to a solvent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 头晕、发困，是吸入过量的信号。

shots.scene: 小研扶阿杰到走廊，打开窗户
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student into the corridor near an open window.
shots.narration: 马上离开，到空气新鲜的地方。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告，老周检查通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man, who checks the fume hood airflow.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，查清通风哪里出了问题。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 症状不缓解，及时就医，急救120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现心脏、肝脏、大脑图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a heart, a liver and a brain.
shots.narration: 伤心伤肝伤脑，还可能致癌。

shots.scene: 通风柜和合适手套两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: a fume hood and a pair of chemical-resistant gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内操作，不敞口挥干，选对手套。

shots.scene: 含卤废液桶和晕眩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed waste container and a dizzy person pictogram with an exit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 废液单收，头晕就撤。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好的通风柜旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a tidy fume hood with its sash closed.
shots.narration: 用量再小也认真，下次见！
